units.source_text: （一）《源氏物语》一书，日本人尊之为古典文学之泰斗。

en.t: (1) The Tale of Genji is a book that the Japanese revere as a towering classic of literature.

units.source_text: 辞典举例，大都首先引用此书中语。

en.t: When dictionaries give examples, they usually quote words from this book first.

units.source_text: 此书确系世界最早之散文长篇小说，成立于一○○六年左右，

en.t: This book is indeed the world's earliest long prose novel, and it took shape around 1006,

units.source_text: 比中国最早之长篇小说《水浒传》《三国演义》早出世三百多年，

en.t: appearing more than three hundred years earlier than China's earliest long novels, Water Margin and Romance of the Three Kingdoms,

units.source_text: 比西洋最早之小说集薄伽丘（Boccàccio）所著《十日谈》（*Decameron*）亦早出世三百多年。

en.t: and also more than three hundred years earlier than the West's earliest story collection, Boccaccio's Decameron.

units.source_text: 书中叙述涉及三代，历时七十多年，

en.t: The narrative in the book spans three generations and more than seventy years,

units.source_text: 登场人物有四百四十多名，亦可谓庞大矣。

en.t: and with more than four hundred forty characters appearing in it, it can also be called vast in scale.
